question_text: Describe how you handle an employee who files a serious complaint against a coworker.
expected_answer: You document the complaint interview both parties review evidence and follow formal investigation procedures

question_text: Explain how you respond when an employee claims they are being treated unfairly by management.
expected_answer: You gather details review policies evaluate the situation objectively and take corrective action if needed

question_text: Describe how you manage an employee who repeatedly violates company policy.
expected_answer: You issue formal warnings provide coaching document behavior and escalate to disciplinary action if required

question_text: Explain how you address a team experiencing ongoing conflict that affects performance.
expected_answer: You meet with the team identify root causes mediate discussions and implement structured improvement steps

question_text: Describe how you support an employee who reports workplace harassment.
expected_answer: You ensure safety document the report begin an investigation and follow legal and company procedures

question_text: Explain how you handle an employee who refuses to follow mandatory compliance training.
expected_answer: You explain the requirement set deadlines document refusal and escalate if noncompliance continues

question_text: Describe how you manage a situation where an employee's behavior threatens team morale.
expected_answer: You address the behavior directly provide feedback set expectations and monitor for improvement

question_text: Explain how you respond when an employee disputes a performance evaluation.
expected_answer: You review the evaluation discuss evidence clarify expectations and adjust only if justified

question_text: Describe how you handle an employee who requests accommodations for medical limitations.
expected_answer: You review documentation evaluate reasonable accommodations and coordinate with leadership to implement support

question_text: Explain how you manage a sensitive termination meeting.
expected_answer: You stay professional explain the decision clearly provide required documents and ensure the employee leaves with dignity
